purpose: Machine-readable catalogue of the abap2UI5 samples in this repository, for AI tooling and other programs. Humans read SAMPLES.md - the same catalogue rendered as a page. Generated by scripts/generate-catalogue.mjs from the one scan behind every view of the catalogue (scripts/lib/scan-samples.mjs); regenerate with `npm run catalogue`, never edit by hand.
role: Step 1 of the three abap2UI5 sample repositories: the learning path - bindings, events, popups, navigation, complete apps. Step 2 is samples-controls (the UI5 demo kit rebuilt, one port per control sample), step 3 is samples-stack (everything that needs the system: OData, RAP, WebSockets, the Fiori Launchpad).

naming.caveat: Sample numbers are handed out per repository, and the three repositories reuse each other's numbers freely - there is no global number space. A number alone therefore names nothing: the class prefix is what says which repository's sample you mean. Always use the full class name.
naming.example: z2ui5_cl_smp_app_493 (here: Hello World) and z2ui5_cl_smps_app_493 (samples-stack: a FilterBar with variant management) share the number 493 and have nothing to do with each other.

scope: One entry per sample in src/01 - the portable set every branch and build ships. The src/00 system area (experimental and testing apps, stripped from the 702 branch) and the hidden ZZZ helper classes are listed in SAMPLES.md only.

learningPath.title: Start here
learningPath.blurb: Five apps in reading order. One class, one view, one roundtrip - the shape every other sample in this repository grows from, plus the developer tools you will open when something does not render.

learningPath.title: Get your data on screen
learningPath.blurb: How an ABAP field becomes something a user reads and edits: binding an attribute, the types that convert it, formatters, and views built from data rather than written out.

learningPath.title: Show many rows
learningPath.blurb: Internal tables on screen - the responsive table, the grid table for large sets, lists and trees - with growing, selection, editing and everything a row can carry.

learningPath.title: Talk to the user
learningPath.blurb: The other direction: events arriving from the view, messages and message boxes going back, and the popups, popovers and menus that ask before something happens.

learningPath.title: Move through the app
learningPath.blurb: More than one view and more than one app: navigation and app calls, views nested inside views, and the small things that decide where the user is looking - focus, scrolling, a timer.

learningPath.title: Reach outside the view
learningPath.blurb: Where an app stops being only a view: the browser it runs in, the device it runs on, files in and out, custom CSS, and driving a control from the backend by its id.
